Thanks Ava. Quick summary of findings from the billing logs:
- Promo REDWOOD100 (PROMO-PLG-031) was marked as redeemed for a different account created earlier today: user id 9f2b4a. The redemption log shows a failure code for emma@saaslabs.com: "account_mismatch" which indicates signup completed under two distinct user ids (email uniqueness race).
- There is no automated retry path for this exact race condition; the coupon engine treats the second redemption as invalid to prevent double grants.

Proposal: manual issuance of 1,500 credits to the canonical account for emma@saaslabs.com. I have a manual credit form we use for these cases — we'll run the issuance and record TXN ID. Estimated completion: ~30–45 minutes after approval.

I've attached the manual_credit_form.pdf and included the recommended audit note to add to the HubSpot record and billing ticket TICKET-3456.

Would like Ben's sign-off to proceed. The total dollar-equivalent is under our manual-credit approval threshold.

Attachment: manual_credit_form.pdf

Thanks,
